after_description: SARA native provided itemized-deduction events, strictly {person:string,tax_year:integer,itemized:boolean}. itemized=true records an expressly provided itemized deduction for the stated person and year, including an explicitly allowed itemized deduction amount; no extra declaration of election is required. Generic income or unspecified potential eligibility is not this event. null means unread/failed, [] means resolved finite extraction with no event.
before_description: 已解析的实际选择/列举记录；每个对象严格为 {person:string,tax_year:integer,itemized:boolean}。itemized 表示实际列举，而非列举资格、可扣除项目或金额。数组 null 表示该事实未解析。
source_of_change: official SARA v2 statute-only section63.pl s63_c_6_A; no case/TEST members read
why: Remove an extra factual election requirement introduced by teacher interface interpretation, not by the native task.
